FGDC-2086.rationale: The title, abstract and purpose identify a FERHRI oceanographic station database and an explicit workflow in which the observations remain in Russia for processing while research results may become available. The XML reports approximate station totals, survey date spans and measured parameter categories; it contains no station identifiers, station coordinates, profile rows, measured temperature/salinity/oxygen values, processing instructions or computed research results. The spatial values 162/-158/70/50 identify the regional Bering Sea coverage, not station locations. Custodian identity/address is explicitly a data contact. This source-specific positive data-processing context supports restoring the exact description under separate existing authority while preserving the foreign-user classification, unavailable-for-analysis statement and Russia-processing condition. No declassification, entitlement of foreign users, processing permission or finding that results were released is asserted.

The finite interpretation preserves database sensitivity and the source FOIA restriction literally; it neither decides a FOIA exemption, releases inspection records, nor treats institutional contacts as protected vessel data. Restoration relies on separate existing authority.

rows.rationale: The abstract identifies automation of native routes from a specifically named James Kari work as one layer of the separate CRNA Subsistence Database (Record#061). The quoted Ahtna phrase is the work title and its English gloss, not a route itinerary or protected participant record. The complete XML supplies no trail/route names, endpoints, path geometry, traversals, site locations or subsistence-user roster. Its spatial values -145.5/-141.5/63/60.42 are one collection box; no coordinate is tied to a route. James Kari is a source-author reference and the other individual names are explicit custodial/metadata contacts. This supports a finite separate-route-layer interpretation preserving the names-removed delivery clause and trespass/vandalism publication restriction without claiming delivery, prior redaction, permission to reproduce routes, or culturally sensitive data release.
